γέγωνέ: γεγωνέω — call out, make oneself heard; perf. γέγωνε 3 sg. with pres. sense, accented before enclitic τε, + dat. of those addressed
γλυκερῷ: γλυκερός — sweet; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
γνώῃ: γιγνώσκω — get to know, recognise; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ώῃ (= Attic γνῷ): ’she may recognise’
δάος: δάος — torch(es); neut. acc. sg., rare collective form (elsewhere δαΐς, δαΐδα), from δαίω ’kindle’
δέμνι: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέμνι’ = δέμνια)
δόρπου: δόρπον — supper, evening meal; neut. gen. sg.
εἰσαγαγών: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ζωοῦ: ζωός — alive, living; masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν, gen. ζῶντος): ’alive’
κέατ: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. 3 pl., epic κέαται elided (= Attic κεῖνται): ’they lie’
κήρυκά: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τ’
καλλιζώνων: καλλίζωνος — fair-girdled, beautifully belted; fem. gen. pl., of women (γυναικῶν)
κλισμῷ: κλισμός — chair with a back, armchair; masc. dat. sg.
κοιμηθέντες: κοιμάω — put to sleep; pass. lie down to sleep; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lain down’
λέξο: λέγομαι — lay oneself down, lie down; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= Attic λέξαι): ’lie down!’
οἰοπόλοισιν: οἰοπόλος — lonely, desolate (of mountains); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
οὔλας: οὖλος — thick, woolly, curly; fem. acc. pl.
πέτρῃσιν: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
πορφύρε: πορφύρεος — purple; neut. acc. pl., elided (πορφύρε’ = πορφύρεα), agreeing with ῥήγεα
στοναχῇ: στοναχή — groaning, sighing; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with groaning’
τάρπησαν: τέρπω — delight, satisfy; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτάρπησαν), + gen.: ’had their fill of’
τέως: τέως — meanwhile, for a while; adv., often with μέν
ταρπώμεθα: τέρπομαι — take one’s fill of, enjoy (+ dat.); aor. subj. mid. 1 pl.: ’we may take our fill’
φαινομένηφιν: φαίνομαι — appear, show oneself; pres. part. (dat. sg. sense) φαινομένηφιν, the rare -φι(ν) suffix, elsewhere confined to nouns, attached here unusually to a participle: ’(Dawn) as she appears’ — a genuinely rare formation
χαίρετ: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad, farewell; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (χαίρετ’ = χαίρετε) ’be glad’, with dat. of what gives joy; also a parting word ’farewell’ · also indic. 2 pl. (same form)
ἐγκονέουσαι: ἐγκονέω — bustle, hasten, be busy; pres. part. fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐγκονοῦσαι): ’bustling’
ἐμβαλέειν: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, cast upon; aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic ἐμβαλεῖν): ’to throw on’
ἐνθέμεναι: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐνθεῖναι): ’to put in’
ἐρρώσαντο: ῥώομαι — move with vigour, dart, rush; aor. 3 pl. mid. (of the knees): ’moved briskly’ · also of warriors: ’surged, moved vigorously’ (in their armour); aor. 3 pl. mid.
ἑτέρου: ἕτερος — the other (of two), another; masc. gen. sg., with τοῦ and τοίχου: ’the other (wall)’
ἔλων: ἐλαύνω — drive (a chariot, etc.); aor. 3 pl., root aorist, unaugmented: ’they drove’
ἕσασθαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. inf. mid.: ’to wear, put on (for oneself)’
ἡβώοντες: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth (ἥβη); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic lengthening (= Attic ἡβῶντες)
ὅσσος: ὅσος — how great, how much; epic ὅσσος; masc. nom. sg., in an indirect question
ῥήγεα: ῥῆγος — rug, coverlet (laid on a bed); neut. nom./acc. pl.
